authority: Project coordinator acting under delegated owner authority for this prebuild POC
edition: Kickoff release V0 with Team Update 00

requirements.auto: Begin legally preloaded with at most eight; reach the own-alliance HUB sensor while active.
requirements.shift: Acquire, transport and score 24 by end of active shift when the entire allocation is already onboard by second five.
requirements.fallback: If the final piece is not onboard by second five or interrupted, count only remaining observed stock and active seconds. Collect and retain during the next inactive shift.
requirements.traffic: Remain in the own zone. Preserve possession during an interrupted crossing; shed the neutral route and yield to the partner.
requirements.measurement: Track each observed intake crossing, retained identity, gate release, complete opening crossing and downstream sensor crossing on the same timebase.
requirements.endgame: Compare remaining expected active HUB points to 10 for an independently supported low-rung hang. Reserve route time plus nine seconds at the tower and verify all required contacts at assessment. Finish current service if its credible points are larger; reserve a second approach for the partner only with verified footprint clearance.
